answers.text: I do not wish to include schools that qualify through either criterion broadly, nor do I require both conditions to be met simultaneously. I specifically require schools to satisfy the high academic achievement definition of priority designation, which mandates that the excellence rate exceeds fifty percent.

turns.sql:
SELECT f."School Name" AS school_name,
       f."District Name" AS district_name,
       s.NumGE1500,
       s.NumTstTakr,
       CAST(s.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / NULLIF(s.NumTstTakr, 0) AS excellence_rate
FROM frpm f
JOIN satscores s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE f."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1
  AND s.NumTstTakr IS NOT NULL
  AND s.NumGE1500 IS NOT NULL
  AND CAST(s.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / NULLIF(s.NumTstTakr, 0) > 0.5;
